responsible_operation_candidates.intent: Remove the unsupported full-width rear lower foot responsible for dominant rear excess volume while retaining the narrow central base.
Replace the inherited full-width rectangular rear bridge with the symmetric tapered transition supported by paired lateral missing regions.
Preserve the verified radius while extending the analytic arc to the forward junction and raising the descending housing boundary.
Replace the displaced vertical lower connector end with an inclined end reaching the paired missing patch.
Move only the mid-height outer lever edge rearward and slope it to the unchanged overall-length top.
Fuse the retained and corrected features into one native editable watertight solid.
